info.title: retrace
info.description: Search, read, and resume AI coding sessions across harnesses. Indexes OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Copilot in VS Code into one local hybrid (BM25 + local ONNX embeddings) search index. Ships as a CLI (`retrace`), an interactive terminal browser (`retrace tui`), and an MCP server (`retrace mcp serve`) in one .NET 10 binary.

options.name: --source
options.description: Restrict to these sources. Repeatable.

options.name: --force
options.description: Re-read everything, ignoring watermarks and content hashes. [default: False]

options.name: --prune
options.description: Remove indexed sessions that no longer exist in their source. [default: False]

options.name: --no-embed
options.description: Skip vectors. Much faster; search runs keyword-only. [default: False]

options.name: --backfill
options.description: Also add vectors to sessions that are already indexed but have none, such as those picked up by an automatic refresh. Only the sessions actually missing vectors are re-read, so this is far cheaper than --force. Scope it with --source or --since: a source left keyword-only on purpose can represent hours of work. [default: False]

options.name: --since
options.description: Only index sessions updated since this point, as a date (2026-01-31) or a duration (90d, 12h). On its own it only narrows which sessions are considered; an already-indexed session is still skipped, so pair it with --backfill to add missing vectors or --force to re-read regardless. A scoped build does not advance the watermark, so a later unscoped refresh still backfills what was excluded.

options.name: --until
options.description: Only index sessions updated before this point. Same formats as --since.
